title: Inside Alysa Liu’s Louis Vuitton Look for the Academy Museum Gala
text:
Alysa Liu's Louis Vuitton Look at 2026 Academy Museum Gala [Photos] 
 Alysa Liu in Louis Vuitton at the 2026 Academy Museum Gala
 Image Credit: Courtesy Photo 
 “This was a new look for me and I loved it! It has the perfect mix of edgy and classy. I truly felt so confident and proud to share this look at the event.”
 Alysa Liu in Louis Vuitton at the 2026 Academy Museum Gala
 Image Credit: Courtesy Photo 
 “I love a reason to get all glammed and fitted up. I love being a girl.”
 Alysa Liu in Louis Vuitton at the 2026 Academy Museum Gala
 Image Credit: Courtesy Photo 
 “Anthracite sequins! Say less.”
 Alysa Liu in Louis Vuitton at the 2026 Academy Museum Gala
 Image Credit: Courtesy Photo 
 “One of my favorite features of my look was that my skirt had two pockets!”
 Alysa Liu in Louis Vuitton at the 2026 Academy Museum Gala
 Image Credit: Courtesy Photo 
 “I can’t stop thinking about the fact that I’m wearing this stunning top. The embroidery took 250 hours! Craftsmanship at its core.”

 “I love starting my night with my glam team, always a blast and really sets the tone for the night. Always lots of laughter in the room while we blast music.”
